summary: Session 3 completed for the Next.js/Zustand/TanStack Query CRM learning track. Covered Zustand state ownership, create/state/actions, immutable updates, narrow selectors, row-level subscription behavior, array vs Set trade-offs, persist/partialize, and Next.js hydration concerns. Durable mental model: API/server state -> TanStack Query; local UI -> useState; shared client UI -> Zustand; shareable navigation state -> URL searchParams. Added working examples to namnx-vn/crm-demo: src/features/ui/useUiStore.ts, CustomerRow.tsx, BulkActionBar.tsx, integrated selection into CustomerTable.tsx, and expanded learning-plan/day-06-zustand.md. Next learning step is Session 4: end-to-end integration of Next.js + TanStack Query + Zustand in CRM.
